title: V3.4 Safety Backfire Ground-Truth Event Schema
description: Standardized schema for candidate safety backfire events, multi-reviewer adjudication, and ground-truth evidence tracking.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this safety backfire candidate or ground-truth event.

facility_id.description: Identifier for the operational facility or benchmark scene (e.g., Warehouse_026, Warehouse_027).

source_dataset.description: Name and provenance of the underlying dataset (e.g., nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces).

source_video_id.description: Source video file or camera identifier where the event was primarily observed.

pre_start.description: Start timestamp of the baseline pre-intervention window (seconds).

pre_end.description: End timestamp of the baseline pre-intervention window (seconds).

intervention_start.description: Start timestamp of the active intervention interval (seconds).

intervention_end.description: End timestamp of the active intervention interval (seconds).

post_start.description: Start timestamp of the post-intervention observation window (seconds).

post_end.description: End timestamp of the post-intervention observation window (seconds).

primary_zone.description: Identifier of the primary facility zone where the intervention was intended to mitigate risk.

secondary_zones.description: List of secondary zones where spillover risk or displaced hazards were monitored.

intervention_type.description: Nature of the safety intervention (e.g., FORKLIFT_DECELERATION, WORKER_AVOIDANCE, OPERATOR_STOP, HAZARD_RESPONSE, UNKNOWN).

affected_person_ids.description: Identifiers or track IDs of workers/pedestrians directly involved.

affected_vehicle_ids.description: Identifiers or track IDs of industrial vehicles directly involved.

primary_risk_before.description: Measurable risk metrics in the primary zone during the pre-intervention window.

primary_risk_after.description: Measurable risk metrics in the primary zone during the post-intervention window.

secondary_risk_before.description: Measurable risk metrics in the secondary zone during the pre-intervention window.

secondary_risk_after.description: Measurable risk metrics in the secondary zone during the post-intervention window.

risk_transfer_mechanism.description: Detailed description of the hypothesized or observed causal mechanism transferring risk across spatial zones.

adjudication_notes.description: Detailed notes documenting reviewer consensus, disagreements, and evidence rationale.

evidence_quality.description: Quality and completeness rating of the underlying multi-camera and sensor evidence.

causal_link_confidence.description: Confidence level in the causal link between the primary intervention and secondary risk alteration.

review_status.description: Lifecycle governance status of this event record.
